title: We haven't eaten dinner as a family since my kids were babies
summary: . And it's the reason they eat every single vegetable.
caption: We haven't eaten dinner as a family since my kids were babies. And it's the reason they eat every single vegetable. I sat with them. But I didn't eat with them. Why it works in the caption 👇 --- **Caption:** Everyone told me I had to do family dinner with my kids, but we almost never did family dinner, and I'd do it the same way again. Here's why. When you're trying to eat your own dinner, you have no patience left for a toddler complaining about the food you made. So you give in. Out comes the grilled cheese, just so you can eat in peace. We've all been there! So I split dinner in two: The kids ate first, and I sat with them for the whole meal. I didn't eat. I talked with them and helped to get them to eat veggies and everything I had cooked one tiny bite at a time. I ate after they were done, in peace. Since I wasn't also trying to eat, I could stay calm, offer the next bite and not cave. I was 100% present for the hard part. My kids are 12 and 9 now, and they eat every vegetable you can name. Tell me in the comments what would make it hard in your house.
